aboutSection.name: Michael Mayer
welcomeText: With more than 9 years of experience in software engineering, I specialize in end-to-end full-stack development. I design robust, scalable, and maintainable software solutions across the frontend, backend, APIs, and database layers, while also overseeing operations and observability. I routinely translate business requirements and user experience into technical implementations that drive efficient, reliable systems deployed in the cloud. I thrive on solving complex business and technical challenges and delivering user-friendly IT solutions that align with strategic goals.
